question.prompt:
In the polygon shown, each side is perpendicular to its adjacent sides, and all \(28\) of the sides are congruent. The perimeter of the polygon is \(56.\) The area of the region bounded by the polygon is

[Figure 1](figures/1994_AMC_12_Q08_question_fig1.svg)

solutions.explanation:
The equal sides make the staircase easy to measure. Since its \(28\) sides have total length \(56\), each side has length
\[
56\div28=2.
\]
Cut horizontally through the inward corners to divide the polygon into seven rectangular strips. Each strip has height \(2\). The top strip has width one side length. Moving downward toward the middle, each boundary steps outward by one side length, so the width increases by two side lengths each time. Below the middle, the steps reverse. Thus the strip widths, from top to bottom, are
\[
2,\ 6,\ 10,\ 14,\ 10,\ 6,\ 2.
\]
These strips fill the polygon and have no overlapping interiors, so their areas add to
\[
2(2+6+10+14+10+6+2)
=2\cdot50=\boxed{100}.
\]
The answer is choice \(\boxed{\text{C}}\).
solutions.title: Divide the staircase into strips
